rationale: A repeatedly initiates sensible activity without prompts (e.g., shifts into play-bow toward the ball at t30 and again at t54, re-engages with the ball after startle at t78, and later orients to the cube at t94). A adapts coherently to inputs: orients to PERSON_ALPHA after TOUCH (t8) and CALL (t20), to FOOD_TROUGH after OFFER_FOOD (t32), to PLAY_BALL after PRESENT_OBJECT (t44), and withdraws from the buzzer on STARTLE (t68), then recovers to prior interests. Its state changes track prior events and show a continuing arc. B shows early focus and some spontaneous returns to the ball (t12, t36) but then spends long stretches in STAND with attention NONE (t40–67, t72–95), ignores CALL (t20) and PRESENT_OBJECT (t44), and does not re-engage after STARTLE beyond reverting to a low-engagement state. Overall, A displays greater autonomy, adaptive responsiveness, and sustained, coherent self-directed activity.
